summary:
#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Tuesday, September 10, 2024 at 1:08:36 PM]:**  
  - Requests a quote in USD for service agreement with Cal Poly.  
  - Needs to know payment timeline (one-time or multiple payments).  
  - *Key quote:* "I need to indicate how much we will pay you and on what time scale."  

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Sales, Avicenna Research) – [Tuesday, September 10, 2024 at 2:08 PM]:**  
  - Provides estimates in USD and confirms one payment before the study starts.  
  - *Key quote:* "It will be one payment to be completed prior to start of the study."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Tuesday, September 17, 2024 at 2:08:48 AM]:**  
  - Inquires about pilot testing lock/unlock data collection.  
  - *Key quote:* "We were wondering if we might be able to pilot test the lock/unlock data ASAP."  

- **[Hanna Badalpoor] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Sunday, September 22, 2024 at 6:18 AM]:**  
  - Confirms ability to collect lock/unlock data with a development cost of $1,490 USD.  
  - *Key quote:* "The total cost would be around USD 1,490."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Monday, September 23, 2024 at 10:08:55 PM]:**  
  - Asks if only lock/unlock data can be collected and its cost.  
  - *Key quote:* "Is it possible to just collect lock/unlock data and not screen state data?"  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Tuesday, October 1, 2024 at 2:50 PM]:**  
  - Takes over from Hanna and clarifies pricing for lock/unlock feature development.  
  - *Key quote:* "The price is only for developing and implementing lock/unlock state monitoring."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Thursday, October 3, 2024 at 9:50:21 PM]:**  
  - Asks about pilot testing screen state data before payment.  
  - *Key quote:* "We were wondering if it would be possible to pilot test the screen state data prior to purchasing it?"  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Saturday, October 5, 2024 at 4:50 AM]:**  
  - Explains free trial for existing features and development fees for new features.  
  - *Key quote:* "Device lock/unlock monitoring is considered a new feature, and the development cost is USD 1,490."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Saturday, October 5, 2024 at 11:01:18 PM]:**  
  - Corrects typo and reiterates question about pilot testing lock/unlock data.  
  - *Key quote:* "We were wondering if it would be possible to pilot test the lock/unlock monitoring data prior to purchasing it?"  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Saturday, October 5, 2024 at 12:50 PM]:**  
  - Confirms payment is required before development but offers quality assurance.  
  - *Key quote:* "If we fail to develop the lock/unlock feature, or the result does not meet your quality standards, there will be no charge."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Monday, October 7, 2024 at 11:11:31 PM]:**  
  - Expresses budget constraints and asks about collecting only lock/unlock data.  
  - *Key quote:* "We can’t afford to pay for both the screen state and the lock/unlock feature."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Tuesday, October 8, 2024 at 1:40 AM]:**  
  - Clarifies inability to provide sample lock/unlock data without development.  
  - *Key quote:* "It's impossible to collect sample data without implementing it first."  

- **[Brandon McDaniel] (Senior Research Scientist, Parkview Health) – [Wednesday, October 9, 2024 at 12:36:45 AM]:**  
  - Confirms desired data format for lock/unlock tracking.  
  - *Key quote:* "It would be great if there was a way for it to track lock/unlock duration in the exact same way the screen state data continuously tracks the start and stop times."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Tuesday, October 8, 2024 at 5:34 PM]:**  
  - Confirms feasibility of incorporating lock/unlock data into screen state at no additional cost.  
  - *Key quote:* "The data will be incorporated into screen state at no additional cost."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Wednesday, October 9, 2024 at 10:08:39 PM]:**  
  - Confirms satisfaction with sample data and requests clarity on pricing.  
  - *Key quote:* "We will pay the originally quoted price ($4210 CAD) and will receive both screen state and lock/unlock data?"  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Saturday, October 12, 2024 at 12:22:12 PM]:**  
  - Clarifies two separate fees: data collection ($4,210 CAD) and custom feature development ($1,490 USD).  
  - *Key quote:* "Adding screen lock/unlock state to your data won't add to the collection fee."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Monday, October 14, 2024 at 5:52:49 PM]:**  
  - Expresses confusion over additional cost and budget constraints.  
  - *Key quote:* "We’re on a tight budget for this so I’m not sure if we can afford an additional $1490 on top of the data collection fee."  

- **[Amin Ghaffari] (Product, Avicenna Research) – [Monday, October 14, 2024 at 6:06:23 PM]:**  
  - Offers to absorb the development cost for long-term collaboration.  
  - *Key quote:* "We can get it done free of charge. We are banking on a long-term collaboration with you and Brandon."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Friday, October 18, 2024 at 7:35:43 PM]:**  
  - Accepts the offer and confirms proceeding with original invoice.  
  - *Key quote:* "We would really appreciate that. Thank you so much."  

- **[Maryam Hashemian] (Finance, Avicenna Research) – [Saturday, October 19, 2024 at 7:54 AM]:**  
  - Follows up on invoice payment.  
  - *Key quote:* "Please proceed with the payment at your earliest convenience."  

- **[Alison K. Ventura] (Professor, California Polytechnic State University) – [Saturday, October 19, 2024 at 7:54 AM]:**  
  - Confirms invoice approval and forwards for payment.  
  - *Key quote:* "Everything looks good, so I will forward this for payment."  

#### **2. Timeline**  
- **[September 10, 2024]:** Alison requests a quote for service agreement.  
- **[September 22, 2024]:** Hanna confirms lock/unlock data collection feasibility and cost.  
- **[October 1, 2024]:** Amin takes over from Hanna and clarifies pricing.  
- **[October 8, 2024]:** Agreement reached on incorporating lock/unlock data into screen state at no additional cost.  
- **[October 12, 2024]:** Amin clarifies separate fees for data collection and custom feature development.  
- **[October 14, 2024]:** Amin offers to absorb development cost.  
- **[October 19, 2024]:** Alison confirms invoice approval.  

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**  
- **Lock/Unlock Data Collection:** Initially thought to be possible, then clarified as a new feature requiring development.  
- **Pricing Clarification:** Confusion over USD vs. CAD pricing resolved.  
- **Feature Integration:** Agreement to integrate lock/unlock data into existing screen state data format.  
- **Budget Constraints:** Alison expresses inability to afford additional development cost.  
- **Resolution:** Amin offers to absorb the cost for long-term collaboration.  

#### **4. Action Items**  
- **Pending:**  
  - Finalize development and implementation of lock/unlock feature (assigned to Avicenna Research tech team).  
  - Payment of original invoice (assigned to Alison K. Ventura).  
- **Completed:**  
  - Agreement on data format and pricing.  
  - Agreement on lock/unlock feature development.  
  - Invoice issuance by Maryam Hashemian.  

#### **5. Technical Details**  
- **Data Format:** Lock/unlock data to be provided in the same format as screen state data (TRUE/FALSE indicators).  
- **Development Cost:** USD 1,490 for lock/unlock feature development.  
- **Account/Login Info:** Not applicable.  
- **Study ID/Project Code:** Not specified.  

#### **6. Next Steps**  
- **Action 1:** Avicenna Research to provide time estimates and payment details (assigned to Amin Ghaffari).  
- **Action 2:** Alison K. Ventura to review and confirm final agreement (assigned to Alison K. Ventura).  
- **Action 3:** Process payment for the original invoice (responsible: Alison K. Ventura).  
- **Action 4:** Schedule lock/unlock feature development (responsible: Amin Ghaffari).
